name: graph-read
body: The behaviour that serves a graph read against the live projection. When a session owns `db.lbug`, the read is routed to the live session over the transparent socket (read-through) and returned from there; when no session is live, the reader opens `db.lbug` directly (read-only) on the direct path. A direct open during a live session is out of contract — lbug's contended open errors rather than waits — so it must route or be retried after the session ends. This is what makes read-your-writes hold for a new process on the direct path and read-access-during-session hold (for routed readers) while a session owns the DB.
